summary: Quaffing a see-invisible potion stops at an explicit peffects refusal after the wish and quaff command match C. potion.c:peffect_see_invisible already has a fruit-juice preamble in JavaScript, but its see-invisible continuation is unreachable. The shared function must use intrinsic HSee_invisible for the permanent-effect chance, update blindness and see-invisible duration in source order, and reach the existing monster/hero redraw calls. The void display.c:set_mimic_blocking call remains a documented gap.

source.branch: For POT_SEE_INVISIBLE, peffects enters the shared peffect_see_invisible taste branch, skips the POT_FRUIT_JUICE nutrition return, clears temporary blindness unless cursed, then grants permanent see-invisible with blessed rn2(10 - 3*Boolean(HInvis) - 6*Boolean(HSee_invisible)) or a timed rn1(100,750) effect; it redraws and may report a previously invisible hero. The fruit-juice arm must retain its existing behavior.
callers: potion.c:peffects dispatches POT_SEE_INVISIBLE and POT_FRUIT_JUICE to peffect_see_invisible; the quaff path reaches peffects from dopotion/dodrink. js/potion.js:peffects currently refuses POT_SEE_INVISIBLE and calls the shared function for POT_FRUIT_JUICE.
dependencies: potion.c:make_blinded, display.c:see_monsters, and display.c:newsym already have JavaScript implementations; preserve their runtime caller environment and source order.
display.c:set_mimic_blocking is an unported void callee whose return is discarded; preserve note_unported without inventing its effects.

HSee_invisible is u.uprops[SEE_INVIS].intrinsic (youprop.h:150), while See_invisible includes extrinsic sources (youprop.h:152); the current JavaScript permanent-chance expression incorrectly uses the latter.

evidence: challenges/evaluations/20260928083103-v10.json records 28/31 matching screens and 2309/2317 matching RNG calls, then the explicit peffects POT_SEE_INVISIBLE refusal at step 28.

nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:841-880 defines the whole shared peffect_see_invisible function, its fruit-juice early return, noncursed blindness clearing, blessed permanent chance or timed effect, redraws, and invisible-hero message.

nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1356-1359 dispatches both potion types into that function. js/potion.js:1719 throws for POT_SEE_INVISIBLE; js/potion.js:1318-1377 has a partial implementation called only by fruit juice and uses See_invisible rather than HSee_invisible in permchance.
